name: forsvn-dev
description: Software-engineering skills extracted from the FORSVN growth stack — architecture, refactoring, dead-code cleanup, service extraction, in-product UX flow + UI specs, code/operator docs, engineering task breakdown, and native app builds. A companion to forsvn (the marketing/growth product), not the product itself.

interface.shortDescription: Software-engineering skills — the build-side companion to FORSVN
interface.longDescription: FORSVN Dev is the engineering companion to FORSVN's marketing/growth stack: architect-system for tech blueprints, map-user-flow and brief-product-ui for in-product UX, breakdown-tasks for engineer task lists, clean-code / extract-service for refactoring, write-docs for code and operator documentation, and build-ios-apps for native app shipping. Install it alongside forsvn when you want the build-side skills as well — it is a separate package, not the FORSVN product.
defaultPrompt: Design the architecture for this feature: schema, API, and deployment.
Audit this codebase for dead code and refactor the messy parts.
Break this technical initiative into an ordered engineer task list.
Write the README, API reference, and runbook for this service.
Map the in-product screen flow before we build the UI.
